Julia (sales): FYI Helion asked for a performance POC next week: mixed workload (embeddings + chat gen + retrieval). Needs sustained + short spikes, multi-AZ failover, private deploy with KMS. Can we draft runbook + ballpark cost?
Sam (eng): Clarify steady vs spike profile?
Julia (sales): Steady ~200 RPS (embeddings heavy), ~50 chat-gen RPS. Spikes up to ~1500 RPS for 5-10m every ~2h. SLOs: p95 embedding <200ms, p99 gen tokens <400ms if possible.
Maria (eng-ml): For that mix recommend Dedicated cluster, KV prefix caching for chat, 4-bit quant for embeddings, and prewarm model shards.
Kevin (eng-sre): Multi-AZ options: active/active or active/passive failover. Cross-AZ latency adds ~20-40ms; need network headroom for bursts.
Sam (eng): Proposed runbook: 1) Baseline sustained 200 RPS for 30m. 2) Three spike tests at 1500 RPS for 10m each with 10m cooldown. 3) Failover drill. Use vegeta for shaping. Example:
```bash
vegeta attack -rate=200 -duration=30m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > baseline.json
vegeta attack -rate=1500 -duration=10m -targets=spike_targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > spike1.json
```
Sam (eng): targets ratio: embeddings:chat = 4:1, include 60s ramp warmup.
perf-bot: Baseline result (200 RPS, 30m): embeddings p50=85ms p95=210ms p99=342ms. Gen token latencies p95=370ms p99=610ms — gen nodes underprovisioned.
Maria (eng-ml): Traces show gen tail due to cold-starts and KV-cache misses during spikes. Preloading KV and enabling prefix caching reduced p99 by ~30-40% in our lab runs. Also fallback to lighter gen model for spikes helps.
Kevin (eng-sre): Security snippet for Helion: private deployment supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/GCP CMEK), TLS 1.2+, disk encryption with customer keys, audit logs exportable to customer SIEM, SOC2 compliance and regular pentests. Confirm mTLS for on-prem connectors.
Julia (sales): Pricing: what's a ballpark for 1-month POC (dedicated cluster + burst)? Any commit discount for 3 months?
Sam (eng): Ballpark: 8x A100-equivalent dedicated nodes + burst buffer ~ $35k-50k/month depending on reserved hours. 3-month commit ~15-25% discount (TBD with pricing).
Julia (sales): Next steps: schedule a 2-hour run with Helion ops (baseline + 1 spike + failover). Sam will produce a 1-page results writeup + appendix with commands, p95/p99, plots, and recommendations. I'll send calendar + security questionnaire.
Sam (eng): I'll prepare Results JSON template and include vegeta commands, prometheus query samples, and cost breakdown. Minimal example we'll output: {\"sustained\": \"rps=200 p95=210 p99=342\", \"spike\": \"rps=1500 p95=520 p99=1200\", \"notes\": \"KV prewarm reduces p99 ~35%\"} 
Julia (sales): Great. Wed 10:00 PT proposed to Helion — @Sam @Maria confirm. :thumbsup:
Sam (eng): Confirmed.
Maria (eng-ml): Confirmed.
Kevin (eng-sre): I'll standby for failover window; may need adjust if maintenance collides.
Julia (sales): I'll share Helion questionnaire and follow up on pricing after baseline.
